content_sections.heading: About DoR Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The vacancy circular is issued by the Competent Authority Cell of the Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance, Government of India, from Room No. 14108, Kartavya Bhawan-1, 4th floor, C Wing, New Delhi. The post is in the Office of the Competent Authority & Administrator, New Delhi. The circular has been sent to all Ministries and Departments of the Government of India, the Competent Authorities (SAFEMA/NDPSA) at Delhi, Kolkata, Mumbai and Chennai, and enforcement and security organisations, with requests to circulate it among IRS officers under CBDT and CBIC.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible officers may send their application along with Bio-data in the prescribed proforma through proper channel to this address: Shri Tarandeep Singh, Under Secretary (Ad. 1 C), Department of Revenue, Room No. 14108, 4th Floor, 'C' Wing, Kartavya Bhavan -1, New Delhi – 110001 The address block in the notice also gives Email: [email protected] and Tel. No.: 011-24012544. The application must reach the office within 30 days from the date of issue of the Vacancy Circular (12 November 2026). Any application received after the due date or without the necessary Annexures will not be entertained. The application proforma ("Application for Vacant Post in Competent Authority & Administrator, New Delhi"), Annexure I and Annexure II are attached to the vacancy circular, which can also be downloaded from the Department of Revenue website, https://dor.gov.in . The proforma has a box for a photograph and asks for: name and address (in block letters), email ID, contact number, date of birth, date of entry into government service, date of retirement as per parent cadre rules, educational qualifications, current designation, current pay matrix and number of years in the current pay matrix. Applicants must state clearly whether they meet the essential qualification and work experience, and give employment details in chronological order (office, post held, from, to, scale of pay, nature of duties), on a separate signed sheet if needed. Pay-band and Grade Pay granted under ACP/MACP are personal to the officer and should not be mentioned as the pay of the post; only the pay of the post held on regular basis is to be given. ACP/MACP details may be shown in a separate table. Officers currently on deputation or loan must give the date of initial appointment, period of deputation/contract, parent office and the post and pay held in substantive capacity; details of any earlier deputation, with the date of return, must also be given. All fields in the Application Proforma/Checklist are mandatory. An incomplete application will not be considered and will be rejected without any intimation.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Post: Joint Commissioner, Group 'A' Gazetted – 01 post, method of recruitment: Deputation. a. Officers under the Central Government: (i) holding analogous posts on a regular basis in the present cadre or department; or (ii) with five years' service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on regular basis in the scale of pay Rs.15600-39100 with grade pay Rs.6600, pay Level – 11 (7th CPC) or equivalent in the parent cadre or department; and b. Possessing 10 years' experience in enforcement of regulatory laws or investigation of offences and collection of intelligence relating thereto. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification; eligibility is based on service and experience as above. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of the post. The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation shall not exceed 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of application. The period of deputation, including the period of deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately preceding this appointment in the same or some other organisation or department of the Central Government, shall ordinarily not exceed four years.

rows.pay_level_pay: ₹ 15,600 – 39,100 + G.P. Rs. 7,600; Level -12 (As per the 7th CPC)

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application with Bio-data in the prescribed proforma Cadre Clearance Vigilance Clearance Statement giving details of major or minor penalties, if any, imposed on the officer during the last ten years Integrity Certificate Agreed List Status (wherever applicable) History of Posting Clear photocopies of the up-to-date CR/APAR dossier containing CR/APARs of at least five years, duly attested by a Group A officer Annexure II – certificate that the applicant possesses 10 years of experience in enforcement of regulatory laws or investigation of offences and collection of intelligence relating thereto, signed by the candidate and by the employer/Cadre Controlling Authority with seal Annexure I is to be provided directly to the Department of Revenue by the employer/Cadre Controlling Authority. It certifies that: the details in the application are true and correct as per records, and the officer will be relieved immediately if selected; no vigilance/disciplinary case is pending or contemplated against the officer; the officer's integrity is certified; CR dossiers in original or photocopies of APARs/ACR for the last 5 years, authenticated by an officer of the rank of Under Secretary to the Government of India or above, are enclosed; no major/minor penalty has been imposed during the last 10 years, or a list of such penalties is enclosed (as the case may be).

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DoR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one post (01) of Joint Commissioner, Group 'A' Gazetted, in the Office of the Competent Authority & Administrator, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the DoR Joint Commissioner application?
faq.answer: The application must reach the office within 30 days from the date of issue of the vacancy circular, 12 November 2026 – that is, by about 12 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for the Joint Commissioner post?
faq.answer: Central Government officers holding analogous posts on a regular basis, or with five years' regular service in Pay Level-11 (Rs.15600-39100 with grade pay Rs.6600) or equivalent, and with 10 years' experience in enforcement of regulatory laws or investigation of offences and collection of intelligence relating thereto.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the DoR Joint Commissioner deputation?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation shall not exceed 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for the Joint Commissioner post?
faq.answer: The pay is ₹ 15,600 – 39,100 + G.P. Rs. 7,600, Level -12 (As per the 7th CPC).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for DoR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the application with Bio-data in the prescribed proforma, through proper channel and with the listed documents and Annexures, to Shri Tarandeep Singh, Under Secretary (Ad. 1 C), Department of Revenue, Room No. 14108, 4th Floor, 'C' Wing, Kartavya Bhavan -1, New Delhi – 110001.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the deputation period?
faq.answer: The period of deputation, including any immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation in the Central Government, shall ordinarily not exceed four years.

faq.question: Q8. Can a selected officer withdraw the application?
faq.answer: No. The circular says the selected officers shall not be allowed to withdraw his/her application.

faq.question: Q9. Which certificate must the employer send directly to the Department of Revenue?
faq.answer: Annexure I, the certificate by the employer/Cadre Controlling Authority on vigilance status, integrity, APARs for the last 5 years and penalties in the last 10 years, is to be provided directly to the Department of Revenue.

faq.question: Q10. What happens to an application received late or without Annexures?
faq.answer: Any application received after the due date or without the necessary Annexures will not be entertained, and an incomplete application will be rejected without any intimation.
